zh: 我以前每天喝咖啡，现在改喝茶了。
old_en: I used to drink coffee every day, but now I prefer tea.
new_en: I used to drink coffee every day, but now I prefer tea.

zh: 我小时候每天走路去上学，现在坐地铁。
old_en: I used to walk to school every day when I was young, but now I take the subway.
new_en: I used to walk to school every day when I was a kid, but now I take the subway.
